editorial:
Imagine waking up in a Los Angeles apartment to find strange blue lights pulling people into the sky. That is the wild setup of this sci-fi thriller, where a group of friends must barricade themselves inside a high-rise while alien ships hover overhead. The story follows Jarrod and his girlfriend Elaine, along with their wealthy friend Terry and his wife Candice, as they try to survive the night. The vibe is tense and claustrophobic, with the city glowing outside their windows as humanity gets sucked away. You feel the panic as they argue about whether to stay hidden or make a run for it.

The action ramps up when the aliens start hunting survivors floor by floor, and the special effects look surprisingly good for a smaller budget. The acting is decent, though some characters make frustrating choices that might annoy you. The pacing keeps things moving, but the story gets repetitive in the middle. If you love alien invasion movies with cool visuals, you will have fun here. It is best enjoyed streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, renting on Apple TV, or grabbing the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Jarrod and Elaine are captured by the aliens and taken aboard their ship. Jarrod's brain is removed and placed into a new alien body, but his human memories and love for Elaine remain. He fights off other aliens to protect her. The twist reveals that the aliens harvest human brains to power their machines, yet some humans keep their minds. The movie ends with Jarrod, now part alien, looking out at Earth as the invasion continues, leaving you wondering if humanity can still be saved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves alien invasion thrillers and big special effects.
